rows.title: Tres Veces Heroica
notes: “this next song that we're going to be playing, it's from Sones de México Ensemble, Tres Ves Jerónica”
Track on 'Fandango on 18th Street' (2002), Chicago-based Mexican son ensemble; also archived in the Strachwitz Frontera Collection.

rows.title: México lindo y querido
notes: Classic 1952 ranchera made famous by Jorge Negrete in the film 'Siempre Tuya', now a Mexican patriotic standard.

rows.title: La Bamba
notes: “right now we're going to get victor to perform la bomba”
Sydney-based Mexican harpist/mariachi bandleader (Victor Valdes & The Real Mexico Mariachi Band); performs 'La Bamba' as standard mariachi repertoire.

rows.title: Cielito Lindo
notes: “We're going to finish off with a song of yours, actually, Victor. It's called Celito Lindo, ¿sí?”
Sydney-based mariachi harpist Victor Valdes released 'Cielito Lindo' (Jan 2024); matches presenter addressing him directly as a studio guest.
